svg.text: DDR traffic for ONE pass-1 line (SN = 4319 source samples, Np = 8192 outputs)
AxSIZE 3'd3 = 8 B. Two samples per beat; one leading word dropped on odd rows.
Generated ON FABRIC from three scalars per line (A, B, SH) sent over AXI4-Lite.
Same -- the 32 KB idx + 16 KB wq that used to cross DDR every line are gone.
AxSIZE 3'd3 = 8 B. Two samples per beat, fully packed.
6,256 beats/line, carrying 50,044 useful bytes in 50,048 bytes of bus time = 99.99% packing efficiency.
Every remaining stream runs at the full 64-bit width, and the two coefficient streams were not made faster -- they were deleted.
Source: sar_resample_v.v:696 (m_arsize), :970 (m_awsize); on-fabric coefficients via SAR_CGENMODE.
